user.title: Set up Device Linker
user.description: Device Linker links devices that are the same hardware, so Home Assistant shows them together under Linked devices. It looks for devices that share a MAC address or hardware identifier, or that have the same or a similar name, and links strong matches on its own. Each link shows under Device Linker, where you can edit or delete it, or add one by hand with Add link. Other matches show as discovered.

discovery_mac.title: Link {device_a} with {device_b}?
discovery_mac.description: These devices share a MAC address, so this is a strong match even when they are in different areas. {device_a} ({integration_a}) is in {area_a}. {device_b} ({integration_b}) is in {area_b}.

discovery_identifier.title: Link {device_a} with {device_b}?
discovery_identifier.description: These devices share a hardware identifier, such as a Zigbee address, Bluetooth MAC, or serial number. {device_a} ({integration_a}) is in {area_a}. {device_b} ({integration_b}) is in {area_b}.

discovery_name.title: Link {device_a} with {device_b}?
discovery_name.description: These names are similar ({score}). A device with no area is still included, so an unassigned UniFi client can match a device in a room. Different areas are not matched. {device_a} ({integration_a}) is in {area_a}. {device_b} ({integration_b}) is in {area_b}.

error.invalid_mac: Select a discovered MAC address or enter a valid MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.connection_conflict: The MAC address is already assigned to {conflicting_devices}. Select a different MAC address or remove the conflicting device.

abort.already_configured: Device Linker is already set up. To link devices by hand, choose Add link on the Device Linker entry.
abort.device_not_found: A device in this suggestion is no longer available.
abort.linked: Linked. The link is under Device Linker, where you can edit or delete it.
abort.ignored: This link suggestion was ignored and will not be offered again.

init.title: Device Linker settings
init.description: These settings apply to every link. Matching MAC addresses and hardware identifiers, and devices with exactly the same name, are linked automatically when automatic linking is on. With similar names on, a name that is the other name plus words like Camera or a model number (Deck Camera and G4 Deck Camera) is linked too. Other name matches show as discovered for you to confirm. A device with no area can match a device in any area; devices in two different areas never match by name.

data.match_hardware: Match MAC addresses and hardware identifiers

data_description.auto_link_similar: Links names like Deck Camera and G4 Deck Camera without asking. Names that differ by a brand or a place, like Living Room TV and Living Room Apple TV, still ask first.
data_description.auto_link_threshold: How alike two names must be to link them without asking.
data_description.suggestion_threshold: How alike two names must be to show them as discovered.

rescan_suggestions.name: Rescan suggestions
rescan_suggestions.description: Look again for devices that share a MAC address or hardware identifier, or that have the same or a similar name. Strong matches are linked automatically when that setting is on.

reset_dismissed.name: Reset dismissed and unlinked
reset_dismissed.description: Forget ignored suggestions and devices you unlinked, then look again. Pairs you had separated can be linked automatically once more.

auto_linked.title: Device Linker linked {count} devices

user.title: Choose the main device
user.description: Choose the device that already has the MAC address, or select manual entry. Registered MAC addresses appear next to each device.

devices.title: Choose devices to link
devices.description: Select all devices to link to {main_name}. You can select multiple devices.

confirm.title: Confirm the shared MAC address
confirm.description: Selected devices: {linked_device_names}. Confirm the MAC address for {main_name}; it will be added to all selected devices.

data.selected_mac_address: MAC address on the main device

reconfigure.title: Edit link
reconfigure.description: Every device in this link is listed, including {main_name}, the device the MAC address came from. Each address is shown with the device it came from. Choose the address to share: the device that has it becomes the main device, and the others get it. A device you remove is not linked again automatically until you run Reset dismissed and unlinked. To unlink every device, delete this link instead.

data_description.linked_device_ids: The device the MAC address came from is included. Add or remove devices here.
data_description.selected_mac_address: Addresses the devices in this link registered themselves, with the device each came from.
data_description.mac_address: Type an address to use one that isn't listed.
